title: Dishes of Asia
intro: Which country is each dish from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

questions.explain: Wikidata gives China as the country of origin of Jiuniang.

questions.prompt: Which country is chana masala from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives India as the country of origin of chana masala.
Wikidata gives Indonesia as the country of origin of Sekba.
Wikidata gives Indonesia as the country of origin of keumamah.
Wikidata gives Türkiye as the country of origin of çörek.
Wikidata gives China as the country of origin of lamian.
Wikidata gives Iran (Islamic Republic of) as the country of origin of sholezard.
Wikidata gives Japan as the country of origin of yakiniku.
Wikidata gives India as the country of origin of Kanji.
Wikidata gives Türkiye as the country of origin of hünkârbeğendi.
